headline: Orderly overnight range under Thursday's Nvidia-led close, with the Warsh Jackson Hole keynote as the day's decisive checkpoint
body: The Nasdaq-100 cash index closed Thursday at 29,641.56, up 1.43% and effectively at the session high of 29,643.53, after Nvidia's fiscal Q2 report (EPS $2.22, revenue $96.2 billion, up 106% year over year) drove an almost 9% move in the stock and the best day for the technology sector since 4 August. Overnight, NQ futures have given back part of that advance to roughly 29,587, about 0.37% lower, trading inside a contained 29,578.25-29,707.00 range with genuine two-way retracement rather than one-way extension. Marvell's post-earnings drop of more than 7% is holding Nasdaq futures behind S&P 500 and Dow futures. Cross-asset signals are calm: VIX is 14.57, Treasury futures are essentially unchanged, the 2-year is 4.19% and the 10-year 4.66%, and WTI has eased to about $82.98 with Brent near $88.01 as Persian Gulf exports recover toward two-thirds of pre-war levels. The dominant scheduled risk is Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote at 14:00Z, arriving alongside the final Michigan sentiment reading and the BLS preliminary payroll benchmark revision, and 15 minutes after Chicago PMI. No policy statement is expected from the symposium. Because no persistent one-way structure, shallow-pullback continuation or session-extreme holding has been observed, the scheduled catalyst stack is scored as Stress and conditional forecast risk rather than as current Tail. Note that CME equity index futures settle at 21:00Z for the weekend, so the later forecast hours cover a closed market.

lookbackSummary: Over the past 24 hours the assessment stayed in the EA_ON state with Tail between 10 and 14 and Stress between 45 and 54. Two hours late in Thursday's U.S. session were scored trend-up as the Nvidia-driven advance carried the index to a close at 29,641.56, near the day's high. Overnight hours reverted to mixed as futures gave back part of the move inside a contained range. One hour, 09:00Z on 27 August, has no published assessment and is marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The horizon splits into three phases. Through 13:00Z the base case is continued two-way trade inside the overnight range with Stress drifting up on pre-event positioning. From 13:00Z to 16:00Z the U.S. cash open, Chicago PMI at 13:45Z and the Warsh keynote at 14:00Z form the highest-risk stretch, peaking at the 14:00Z hour where the mapped policy state is WATCH; a delayed, rates-first second leg is treated as a real conditional path. From 16:00Z conditional risk decays if price discovery is orderly and retracements occur. CME equity index futures settle at 21:00Z for the weekend, so the final eleven hours cover a closed market where no mean-reversion failure can occur and the residual scores represent unexpressed weekend headline accumulation ahead of the Sunday reopen.
